title: Would like option to alarm faster than 20 minutes, for missed readings.
body: Title says it all.   20 minutes is too long for me to miss readings.  How about 10 minutes?

comments.body: I'd been using 16 minutes for years. Does it not allow to enter that anymore @dave1812?
oh, you are right.   My short-term memory is awful lately.  I DID find the setting recently, and changed it.   Thank you for responding.
